_note: Photos of what each drug looks like (writing rules: 'Photos'). Each is public domain, CC0 or CC BY (CC BY-SA only where nothing else exists, marked), with its credit; the licence was checked on the Commons file page on checked_on. 'file' is the original as saved in the senior author's Images folder; scripts/build_photos.py makes the web copies (site/photos/<id>-m.webp and -t.webp, metadata removed). header: the photo at the top of the drug page. medicine_example: a medicine whose look differs by maker and country. hold: kept out of the site until the page that explains it exists. Version 2 (18 October 2026): every real-life form; no coins, rulers, bags, seizure scenes or watermarks in the frame (cropped out or replaced); dropped: poppers-bottle (blurry); dmt-powder (bag and coin); gbl-bottle (seized parcel); kratom-crushed-leaf (seizure); spice-packet (one brand); fentanyl-fake-pills (bags); heroin-powder (split into brown and white).
